title: Click histochemistry for whole-mount staining of brain structures
author: Alexander Lazutkin
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8rqhv5w

steps.title: Inject EdU into animal
steps.instruction: Inject the synthetic thymidine analogue 5‑ethynyl‑2′‑deoxyuridine (EdU) at a dose of 40–123 mg per kg body weight. Schedule euthanasia according to the experimental timeline.

steps.title: Anesthetize animal before euthanasia
steps.instruction: Administer chloral hydrate at 10 mg per kg body weight immediately prior to euthanasia and allow 10 min for anesthesia.

steps.title: Perfuse animal with fixative
steps.instruction: Perform intracardiac perfusion with 30 mL phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS) followed by 30 mL cold 4 % paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS, pH 7.4, for 1 h 15 min. Handle PFA in a fume hood.

steps.title: Dissect brain
steps.instruction: Dissect the brain within 1 h after perfusion; allocate approximately 5 min for the dissection.

steps.title: Post‑fix brain overnight
steps.instruction: Immerse brain samples in 4 % PFA at 4 °C and incubate overnight (≈14 h).

steps.title: Rinse brain twice with PBS
steps.instruction: Rinse the brain twice with PBS, each rinse lasting 2 h (total 4 h).

steps.title: Isolate hippocampi
steps.instruction: Using a microsurgical spatula, remove the cerebral cortex from the fixed hemispheres, isolate the hippocampi, and place them in a 2 mL microtube containing cold PBS. Perform for ~10 min.

steps.title: Incubate in Dent solution
steps.instruction: Incubate specimens in Dent solution consisting of 100 % methanol and DMSO mixed at a 4:1 ratio, for 2 h at 4 °C. Handle methanol and DMSO with appropriate safety precautions.

steps.title: Bleach specimens in Dent bleach
steps.instruction: Bleach specimens in Dent bleach solution (100 % methanol : DMSO : 30 % H₂O₂ at 4:1:1) under bright light for 2 h until samples appear completely white.

steps.title: Rinse specimens in methanol
steps.instruction: Rinse the bleached specimens three times with 100 % methanol, each rinse lasting 1 h.

steps.title: Optional methanol storage
steps.instruction: Store specimens in 100 % methanol at –70 °C if not proceeding immediately. To warm, transfer sequentially to –20 °C, then 4 °C, and finally to room temperature.

steps.title: Rehydrate stepwise
steps.instruction: Rehydrate specimens sequentially in 75 %, 50 %, 25 % methanol and finally PBS, incubating 1 h in each solution.

steps.title: Wash rehydrated sample
steps.instruction: Wash the rehydrated sample twice with PBS, each wash lasting 1 h.

steps.title: Permeabilize with saponin/DMSO
steps.instruction: Incubate specimens in PBS containing 2 % saponin and 5 % DMSO for 1 h at 37 °C.

steps.title: Wash with Tris‑HCl/Triton
steps.instruction: Wash the permeabilized specimens in Tris‑HCl buffer (pH 8.0) containing 0.2 % Triton X‑100 for 1 h.

steps.title: Perform click reaction
steps.instruction: Prepare click reaction solution immediately before use: Tris‑HCl buffer with 5 % DMSO, 0.2 % Triton X‑100, 0.2 % saponin, 100 mM sodium ascorbate (made fresh from a 1 M stock prepared from powder), 1 mM CuSO₄, and 10 mM fluorescent azide. Incubate specimens in this solution for 2 h in the dark at room temperature.

steps.title: Quench click reaction
steps.instruction: Quench the reaction by three successive 1 h incubations in Tris‑HCl buffer containing 5 % DMSO, 0.2 % Triton X‑100, and 0.1 M EDTA.

steps.title: Wash stained preparation
steps.instruction: Wash the preparation as follows: (a) two 1 h washes in PBS containing 5 % DMSO and 0.2 % Triton X‑100; (b) two 1 h washes in plain PBS; (c) final overnight rinse in PBS at 4 °C (≈18 h).

steps.title: Dehydrate through methanol series
steps.instruction: Dehydrate specimens sequentially in 25 %, 50 %, and 75 % methanol, followed by three 1 h incubations in 100 % methanol (total 6 h).

steps.title: Clear in dibenzyl ether
steps.instruction: Clear specimens overnight (≈14 h) in dibenzyl ether (DBE) kept in the dark at 4 °C. Store cleared samples in DBE if needed and use compatible plastic or glass labware.
